structured.answer: Joining is clearly worth it: at 30,000 I'd put in 750 ₪ a month and the employer 2,250 ₪. Taken out after 5 years that leaves about 136,457 ₪ after 64,761 ₪ tax, and the page says to wait the full 6 years so it's tax-free.

stuck.why: The calculator starts at 5 years, so the first big result I saw (136,457 ₪ after a 64,761 ₪ tax cut) is the early-withdrawal case. I didn't tap year 6+ to get the tax-free amount, and the page doesn't show that number in shekels.
It looks like part of the deposits on my salary goes over the ceiling and gets taxed, but that explanation is in small grey text I didn't read, so I'm not sure how much it affects me.
